clips.speaker: Yvonne
clips.title: 领益智造董事长：电子消费转AIDC，未来五年持续增长

subtitles.en: We see the trend from the electronic consumer, and then it's going to go to the AIDC.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到从电子消费到AIDC的趋势。

subtitles.en: It's going to be really up for the next at least five years.
subtitles.zh: 未来至少五年会持续上升。

subtitles.en: So we are fully speed to focus on that, which is we can share similar of the process.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们全力聚焦于此，可以共享类似流程。

subtitles.en: And then the more complex and difficult of the capability that we kind of shift and copy that into the AIDC industry.
subtitles.zh: 我们将更复杂、更难的能力转移到AIDC行业。

subtitles.en: And then we are already support all the famous names already.
subtitles.zh: 我们已经支持所有知名品牌。

subtitles.en: Then that's going to be another trend.
subtitles.zh: 这将是另一个趋势。

subtitles.en: And then we also use the hardware that then we make the human robot, then from the components also to module and the whole system and testing and then the copy standard.
subtitles.zh: 我们还用硬件做人形机器人，从组件到模块、整系统、测试及复制标准。

subtitles.en: And also we help to do all the justification and service.
subtitles.zh: 我们还帮助做所有验证和服务。

clips.speaker: Yvonne
clips.title: 领益智造董事长：苹果涨价影响有限，已转向手机笔记本

subtitles.en: And then we also, because we have around a hundred thousand employees around the world, outside of China, we have a thirty thousand.
subtitles.zh: 我们在全球有约10万员工，中国以外有3万。

subtitles.en: Then the whole factory, we also have a huge amount of data that we are going to share with all the industry that get together.
subtitles.zh: 整个工厂有大量数据，将与整个行业共享。

subtitles.en: So that's the key.
subtitles.zh: 这是关键。

subtitles.en: And then we believe we can do a lot of achievement to these pros.
subtitles.zh: 我们相信能取得很多成就。

subtitles.en: We just got news that Apple is hiking the prices of its iPad and MacBooks on the back of those memory shortage.
subtitles.zh: 刚得到消息，苹果因内存短缺提高iPad和MacBook价格。

subtitles.en: So I'm wondering as a major supplier, how big of a hit is that going to be for your demand and for your margins?
subtitles.zh: 作为主要供应商，这对需求和利润率影响多大？

subtitles.en: Actually, we knew that earlier because we are very the co-supplier of the industry. So we knew that earlier.
subtitles.zh: 实际上我们早就知道，因为我们是行业联合供应商。

subtitles.en: And then we already kind of shift our capability and the case of it, the case of it into phone, into notebook.
subtitles.zh: 我们已经将能力转向手机和笔记本。

subtitles.en: That two one is still grow.
subtitles.zh: 这两个仍在增长。

clips.speaker: Yvonne
clips.title: 领益智造董事长：人形机器人已锁定30家客户，北美巨头在列
title_lines: 人形机器人锁定30家客户

subtitles.en: And then also with this year, the new affordable things is going to come. And then we focus on that.
subtitles.zh: 今年还有新的平价产品推出，我们聚焦于此。

subtitles.en: We have a lot of new technology for the new phone.
subtitles.zh: 我们有很多新手机技术。

subtitles.en: And then we believe that can help us to digest our capacity.
subtitles.zh: 相信这能帮助我们消化产能。

subtitles.en: So it would not treat the industry too much, you guys.
subtitles.zh: 所以不会对行业造成太大影响。

subtitles.en: You have opened up this new super factory in Beijing, you're targeting, you know, from 10,000 units this year to 500,000 in 2030.
subtitles.zh: 你在北京开了新超级工厂，目标从今年1万台到2030年50万台。

subtitles.en: What is underpinning this confidence and have you locked in, you know, clients for the humanoid robot?
subtitles.zh: 信心何来？人形机器人客户是否已锁定？

subtitles.en: We are locked at least 30 different clients, all the famous ones in China and also the famous one in North America.
subtitles.zh: 我们已锁定至少30家客户，包括中国和北美的知名企业。

subtitles.en: Could you share specifically which are your clients in North America?
subtitles.zh: 能具体分享北美客户吗？

subtitles.en: I'm sorry. Every big name, you can name.
subtitles.zh: 抱歉，每个大牌，你都能想到。

subtitles.en: So every big name, then they're all involved.
subtitles.zh: 所有大牌都参与其中。

subtitles.en: And then even some of the name, you don't know.
subtitles.zh: 甚至有些名字你不知道。

subtitles.en: And then we are doing the first prototype situation.
subtitles.zh: 我们正在做首批原型。

clips.speaker: Yvonne
clips.title: 领益智造董事长：人形机器人2030年后爆发，中国将领先

subtitles.en: Then the Beijing one, we are focused on the China brand.
subtitles.zh: 北京工厂专注于中国品牌。

subtitles.en: So that more than 10 of the China brand is going to use the Beijing facility.
subtitles.zh: 超过10个中国品牌将使用北京工厂。

subtitles.en: We have another facility at Chengdu and another facility at Chengzhou, which is where they have three MP for human role robot.
subtitles.zh: 我们在成都和郑州还有工厂，人形机器人产能达300万。

subtitles.en: And then by this year, so far on hand, where they get more than 30,000 sets of the human role robot's PO on hand.
subtitles.zh: 今年至今，已收到超过3万台人形机器人订单。

subtitles.en: And are you looking at expanding these factories outside of China?
subtitles.zh: 是否考虑在中国以外扩张？

subtitles.en: Yes. Where? Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 是的。哪里？

subtitles.en: We have a factory of the Vennang, India, Brazil, Turkey, France, and the United States and Greenland.
subtitles.zh: 我们在越南、印度、巴西、土耳其、法国、美国和格陵兰有工厂。

subtitles.en: So we are going to follow our customer reply.
subtitles.zh: 我们将跟随客户需求。

subtitles.en: What is the projected demand growth you are seeing in this human role robot sector in the US and in China? I think the really big trend would come after 20, 28, that's my guessing.
subtitles.zh: 你预计美国和中国人形机器人需求增长如何？我认为大趋势在2028年后。

subtitles.en: China is going to be really become more like, for sure, around even 2030. But we would like to do all these supporting in the beginning.
subtitles.zh: 中国肯定会在2030年左右成为重要市场，我们愿意早期提供支持。

subtitles.en: And then one day, we can really become top players in the industry.
subtitles.zh: 总有一天，我们会成为行业顶级玩家。

clips.speaker: Yvonne
clips.title: 领益智造董事长：AIDC电源和散热是重点，已获多家客户样品

subtitles.en: You are looking to comment your tactics to capacity expansion beyond the human role robot factory. Where else are you putting money into?
subtitles.zh: 除了人形机器人，你还把钱投到哪里？

subtitles.en: AIDC, must be the first one.
subtitles.zh: AIDC，必须是第一。

subtitles.en: So we already have a hyper power charger and then for the ACDC to DC to DC to DC, so all this kind of power module is going to be a big area for us to invest.
subtitles.zh: 我们已有超级电源充电器，从AC到DC的各种电源模块将是重点。

subtitles.en: We are actually doing a quite more than eight different customer for making samples.
subtitles.zh: 我们正在为超过8家客户制作样品。

subtitles.en: But the power for AIDC is really needs more than one year to do the verification.
subtitles.zh: 但AIDC电源需要一年以上验证。

subtitles.en: So that big time and then two is our thermal solution.
subtitles.zh: 所以耗时很长，第二是散热方案。

subtitles.en: So the thermal one, which is a higher rear door.
subtitles.zh: 散热方面，我们有高效后门散热。

subtitles.en: So we are going to, that's their media's approved supplier.
subtitles.zh: 我们已成为其媒体认可的供应商。

subtitles.en: So we are going to use that to bring all different production lines into the top customer.
subtitles.zh: 我们将以此将不同生产线引入顶级客户。

subtitles.en: And then we also involved with other components or things for the AIDC.
subtitles.zh: 我们还参与AIDC的其他组件。

subtitles.en: Are you seeing any components shortage in all the sectors you are present in right now?
subtitles.zh: 你现在所在的领域有组件短缺吗？

clips.speaker: Winnie
clips.title: 美银Winnie：美联储紧缩预期，香港楼市承压

subtitles.en: For a few reasons, other than the cross-border liquidity tightening, currently, our house view is forecasting three runs of Fed rate hike.
subtitles.zh: 除了跨境流动性收紧，我们目前预计美联储将加息三次。
en_highlights: three runs of Fed rate hike

subtitles.en: Now, even if it's not three runs, but the prospect of potential Fed tightening is going to be negative for the property markets in Hong Kong.
subtitles.zh: 即使不是三次，美联储紧缩的前景也会对香港楼市产生负面影响。

subtitles.en: Also, historically, Hong Kong's residential property price index tend to be a lagging indicator to HSI. So there's a correlation between stock market and the property market.
subtitles.zh: 历史上，香港住宅价格指数往往是恒生指数的滞后指标，股市与楼市存在关联。

subtitles.en: And if, second half of this year, stock market is in more pressure because of the liquidity drain from older papers, IPOs, because of the competition from the Asia IPO and US IPO as well.
subtitles.zh: 如果下半年股市因老股解禁、IPO竞争面临更大压力，包括亚洲和美国的IPO。

subtitles.en: And also, there is a quite $1.2 trillion Hong Kong dollar of unlocking from the previous IPO that will come to a lock. That's another liquidity drain and with the cross-border tightening.
subtitles.zh: 此外，约1.2万亿港元的前期IPO解禁将到期，加上跨境收紧，又是一次流动性抽水。

subtitles.en: So if Hong Kong market HSI is in more pressure, Hong Kong property will probably see more pressure in the next six months, where more comfortable with the Hong Kong banks.
subtitles.zh: 因此，如果恒生指数承压，香港楼市未来六个月可能面临更大压力，相比之下更看好香港银行股。

clips.speaker_context: APAC Equity Strategy, BofA Global Research

clips.speaker: Winnie
clips.title: 美银Winnie：AI交易仍受追捧，消费刺激不足

subtitles.en: I think it, again, depends on horizon. For the more Ningbo platform, hedge fund, you know, Kuang fund, no problem at all. The momentum is still there.
subtitles.zh: 这取决于投资期限。对于量化平台、对冲基金来说，动量依然存在。

subtitles.en: And the view is at least until next earnings of the hyperscalers, which is like two, three months away. So people, I would say generally, are still quite on the positive side, and there's no compelling alternatives.
subtitles.zh: 至少到超大规模企业下一次财报（两三个月后），市场情绪依然乐观，且没有有吸引力的替代选择。

subtitles.en: I think investors have been talking about broadening out of their trade, looking into defense, industrials, whatever, but the conviction elsewhere in terms of earning certainty, the defensible margins are not as strong as AI.
subtitles.zh: 投资者虽在讨论分散交易，关注国防、工业等，但其他领域的盈利确定性和护城河都不如AI。

subtitles.en: And even just consumption, right in China, for example. I mean, itself reinforcing in some ways, because you know that they're not the stimulus wise.
subtitles.zh: 以中国消费为例，某种程度上自我强化，因为政策并非刺激消费。

subtitles.en: They rather focus on AI, rather focus on advanced manufacturing, not so much consumer demand stimulus.
subtitles.zh: 政策更侧重AI和先进制造，而非消费需求刺激。

clips.speaker_context: APAC Equity Strategy, BofA Global Research

clips.speaker: Winnie
clips.title: 美银Winnie：中国K型分化加剧，散户难赚钱

subtitles.en: I would say that partly because the wealthy fact of the stock market is far less prevailing in China. I mean, you know, Korea, Taiwan, much smaller population, right?
subtitles.zh: 部分原因是股市的财富效应在中国远没有那么普遍。韩国、台湾人口少得多。

subtitles.en: So you know, like I think Samsung has like five million of retail shareholders, lots of millionaires now. Exactly, right? So the wealthy fact is much more evident driving the luxury car sales, you know, the spending in Korea.
subtitles.zh: 三星有500万散户股东，催生了很多百万富翁，财富效应明显，推动韩国奢侈品消费。

subtitles.en: Whereas in China, the wealthy fact in the stock market might only benefiting a very small part of the population, right? The people in Lu Jiazui, and also in Korea, the two stock has done very well over the past 12 months.
subtitles.zh: 而在中国，股市财富效应只惠及极少数人，比如陆家嘴的从业者。韩国两只股票过去12个月表现很好。
en_highlights: only benefiting a very small part

subtitles.en: Whereas in China, even as professionals, we need to constantly look at rotations, changing scenes, right? You know, the stock you bought a year ago, new consumption, right? It's not necessarily making you money today.
subtitles.zh: 在中国，即使是专业人士也需要不断关注轮动和变化。一年前买的新消费股，今天不一定赚钱。

subtitles.en: So for retailers, can they really make money in this kind of rapid rotation? That's another challenge.
subtitles.zh: 对于散户来说，在这种快速轮动中真的能赚钱吗？这是另一个挑战。

clips.speaker_context: APAC Equity Strategy, BofA Global Research

clips.speaker: Winnie Wu
clips.title: 法国巴黎银行吴一鸣：香港市场承压，银行板块更稳

subtitles.en: I mean, relatively speaking, would be more comfortable on the Hong Kong banks and a bit more cautious on the Hong Kong property stocks for a second half of this year.
subtitles.zh: 相对而言，下半年我更看好香港的银行板块，对地产板块则更谨慎。

subtitles.en: For a few reasons, other than the cross-border liquidity tightening, currently, our house view is forecasting three runs of Fed rate hike.
subtitles.zh: 除了跨境流动性收紧，我们内部预测美联储将加息三次。
en_highlights: three runs of Fed rate hike

subtitles.en: Now, even if it's not three runs, but the prospect of potential Fed tightening is going to be negative for the property markets in Hong Kong.
subtitles.zh: 即便不是三次，美联储潜在的紧缩预期对香港地产市场也是利空。

subtitles.en: Also, historically, Hong Kong's residential property price index tend to be a lagging indicator to HSI. So there's a correlation between stock market and the property market.
subtitles.zh: 历史上，香港住宅价格指数滞后于恒生指数，权益市场与地产市场存在关联。

subtitles.en: And if, second half of this year, stock market is in more pressure because of the liquidity drain from older papers, IPOs, because of the competition from the Asia IPO and US IPO as well.
subtitles.zh: 下半年，由于老股解禁、IPO抽血以及来自亚洲和美国IPO的竞争，权益市场面临更大压力。

subtitles.en: And also, there is a quite $1.2 trillion Hong Kong dollar of unlocking from the previous IPO that will come to a lock. That's another liquidity drain and with the cross-border tightening.
subtitles.zh: 此外，约1.2万亿港元的IPO解禁资金即将释放，这又是一次流动性抽离，叠加跨境收紧。

subtitles.en: So if Hong Kong market HSI is in more pressure, Hong Kong property will probably see more pressure in the next six months, where more comfortable with the Hong Kong banks.
subtitles.zh: 因此，如果恒生指数承压，未来六个月香港地产可能面临更大压力，而银行板块则相对稳健。
en_highlights: more comfortable with the Hong Kong banks
